about_the_game:
About This Game

Reality is a matter of perspective. In Either Eye, you don't just explore the nightmare—you expose it.

Either Eye is a narrative-driven psychological horror game. You are trapped in a world that appears peaceful, but a dark reality festers just beneath the surface. To survive, you must master the art of fractured vision.

The Dual Reality

The world around you looks safe. It is the "Good World." But this is a lie. By engaging the Dual-Vision Mechanic, you peel back the veil to reveal the "Evil World"—a decaying, parallel dimension hiding the truth, the monsters, and the keys to your escape.

The Mechanic: Close One Eye

You can't trust both of your eyes.

• Open Eyes: See the physical obstacles and the innocent facade.

• Close One Eye: Reveal hidden messages, demonic entities, and paths that don't exist in the "real" world.

• The Risk: Staring too long into the Evil World attracts the things that live there.

Award-Winning Visuals

Winner of the "Best Pivot" award, Ether leverages the power of UE5 to create a seamless, terrifying transition between beauty and horror. There are no loading screens between realities—only the blink of an eye.

Key Features:

• One Mechanic, Two Worlds: Solve puzzles that require you to manipulate objects in one dimension to affect the other.

• Story-Rich Horror: A "Novel Game" experience where the narrative unfolds through environmental storytelling and terrifying revelations.

• Next-Gen Atmosphere: High-fidelity lighting and shadows that play tricks on your mind.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit/32 bit) or Newer
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Dual core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 760
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit/32 bit) or Newer
  • Processor: 3 GHz Dual core or better
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
